annotation.summary_en: GOV.UK consultation page from the UK Department for Transport, first published in April 2021. It proposed amending The Highway Code to add rules for the safe use of automated vehicles on Great Britain's motorways. Updates in 2022 added the government response, a list of self-driving vehicles, an explanatory memorandum and the Automated Vehicles Order 2022.
key_provisions_or_claims: Proposes a new Highway Code section on safe use of automated vehicles on motorways
Consultation ran 28 April to 28 May 2021, following a 2020 call for evidence on Automated Lane Keeping Systems
Self-driving vehicles listed for use in Great Britain
The Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) (Automated Vehicles) Order 2022 and explanatory memorandum published 25 April 2022
